data.one_liner: A set of strict static analysis rules for Dart and Flutter projects.
data.what_it_does: Provides a collection of strict lint rules for the Dart Analyzer and Dart Code Metrics. It can be integrated into projects via the analysis_options.yaml file to enforce coding standards.
use_when: You want to enforce strict code quality rules across Dart and Flutter projects.
You want a pre-configured set of rules including Dart Code Metrics integration.
avoid_when: You prefer default Flutter lint rules or a completely custom configuration.
Strict rule sets conflict with your current development style.
strengths: Easy integration by including a single yaml file.
Supports both standard analyzer lints and Dart Code Metrics.
weaknesses: Requires managing rule changes and updates across project versions.

alternatives.name: flutter_lints
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Flutter lints provided by the Flutter team.
